effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the effect resolves with no Field Spell left in the Deck, the goat script proves the failed search by revealing the Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. The printed text is behaviourally unchanged.

changes.historical_text: Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.
changes.summary: Separate per-card ruling: the goat script removes the modern activation legality check that a Field Spell exist in the Deck ('if chk==0 then return Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil) end' -> 'return true'), so the Normal Spell can be activated with nothing to fetch. Nothing in the packet dates when this card lost that allowance, so the chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline implements lineage v1 (DR1-EN036, released 2005-03-19, i.e. in force at the GOAT snapshot); v0 (PGD-088, 2003) predates it and only differs by 'Field Magic Card' and the explicit shuffle sentence. Trailing v1 -> v2 (YS17-EN031, 2017) drops the word 'Card' - cosmetic. Reveal and relaxed activation are entangled in play but recorded separately because only the reveal has sourced bounds; the intermediate state needs no implementation, as GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede the earliest possible end of the old verification era (2011-02-02).
